title: My mom has never had a birthday cake
lesson: Every family has someone who makes the birthdays happen. Ask them when somebody last did it for them. Then bake the cake.

today.ELLIE: a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm
today.ANNE: a soft oatmeal cotton cardigan over a pale-blue cotton blouse (a light navy cotton jacket only at the door)

beats.vo: My mom has baked every birthday cake in our family for thirty years. Not one of them was hers.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, stands still on the gravel path beside the strawberry bed, a small empty white enamel colander hanging from one hand, seen from the side, looks down along the bed at the small ripe strawberries, then shifts her weight and slowly lowers herself toward it; she stays in the same place and the camera stays locked off, it does not follow her. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Footsteps on gravel, birdsong.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, standing on the gravel path beside the strawberry bed, a small white enamel colander in one hand, seen from the side, eyes on the plants, a calm ordinary face. Medium-wide shot, a whole person.

beats.vo: Her birthday's tomorrow. So tonight, I'm baking her one. Let me tell you why.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves lifting the green leaves of a strawberry plant, finding one small ripe red strawberry, pinching its stalk and dropping it into the white enamel colander beside a few others. Leaves rustle, birdsong.

beats.vo: Growing up, birthdays in our house were a big deal. Mom made sure of that.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, crouches by the raspberry canes seen from the side, head bowed, eyes on the canes, gently pulls one ripe raspberry free and drops it into the colander on her knee, then reaches for the next. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Leaves rustle.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, crouching by the autumn raspberry canes seen from the side, head bowed, eyes on the canes, the white enamel colander resting on her knee with a few berries in it, a calm ordinary face. Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: Dad got chocolate. My brother got lemon. I got strawberry, every single year.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Close-up of the white enamel colander held in one of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves, only her hands and dusty-rose sleeves in frame, small uneven strawberries and raspberries in it; her other hand adds one more strawberry. Soft garden sound, birdsong.

beats.vo: She'd be up at six to bake before work. Every time.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves pinching off three small purple violas and two orange calendula flowers one by one and laying them on top of the small strawberries and raspberries in the white enamel colander resting on the edge of the bed. Soft garden sound.

beats.vo: Everyone's birthday. Grandpa's. The neighbours' kids. Even the dog's, once.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. An old sleepy golden retriever lies on the warm gravel path in the soft light, slowly lifts its head toward the soft crunch of footsteps on the gravel just out of frame (no person in frame), thumps its tail twice and lays its head down again. Gravel, birdsong.

beats.vo: And on her own birthday?
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, stands up slowly from the strawberry bed with the full colander, stays where she is, looks down at it for a moment, still, then lifts one small strawberry with two fingers and looks at it; she does not walk away and the camera stays locked off. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Birdsong.

Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: She'd wave it off. Oh, don't make a fuss. I don't need anything.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft bright daylight, her small cottage back garden: raised wooden beds of low strawberry plants with small ripe red strawberries, a row of autumn raspberry canes, a clump of mint, orange calendula and small purple violas, a gravel path, an old brick wall. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves pinching two sprigs of mint from the clump and laying them in the white enamel colander, which already holds small uneven strawberries, raspberries, violas and calendula. A soft snap of stems.

beats.vo: So we didn't. A card from the shop. Maybe some flowers from the petrol station.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Seen from inside the kitchen: the back door stands open, its white door leaf and frame in view; Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, stands just inside the open back door holding the white enamel colander full of small garden strawberries, raspberries and flowers in both hands, looks out at the garden for a moment, then reaches out with one hand and slowly pushes the door closed; she stays where she is and the colander stays in her other hand. The camera stays locked off. The door stays solid in its frame. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. A door latch, footsteps.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Seen from inside the kitchen: the white back door stands open, its door leaf and frame clearly in view, the garden behind; Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, standing just inside the threshold holding the white enamel colander, seen from the side at a slight angle, a calm ordinary face. Medium-wide shot, a whole person.

beats.vo: And she'd cook dinner. On her own birthday. For all of us.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves rinsing the small strawberries and raspberries in the white enamel colander under a gentle stream from the tap at the butler sink, turning them softly with her fingertips. Running water.

beats.vo: I never noticed. Not once, in twenty-five years. I'm not proud of that.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, at the sink, seen from the side, dries her hands slowly on a linen tea towel, then stops and looks out of the window at the garden for a moment, still, a calm quiet face. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Quiet kitchen, a far bird.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: Then last year, I went home for her birthday.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves laying the washed berries one by one on a folded linen tea towel on the pale wood worktop to dry, the flowers and mint beside them. Soft cloth sound.

beats.vo: And where was she? In the kitchen. Making a cake.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves cracking one egg on the rim of a cream ceramic bowl and opening the shell with both thumbs, the egg sliding in. A crack and a soft drop.

beats.vo: I asked who it was for. She said, Mrs Patel next door. It's her birthday too.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. A tight close-up looking down at a cream ceramic bowl on the pale wood worktop, only the bowl, a strip of worktop and Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves in dusty-rose knit sleeves in frame (no window, no face): one hand holds a fine sieve over the bowl and the other taps its rim, flour drifting down in soft puffs. The view is fixed and never pans or tilts; the bowl stays centred and the same size from first frame to last. The soft tap of the sieve.

beats.vo: And I said, Mom, when did anyone last make a cake for you?
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, at the worktop seen from the side, head bowed, eyes on the bowl, beats soft butter and sugar together with a wooden spoon in a cream ceramic bowl held against her hip. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. A wooden spoon in a bowl.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: She stopped. She actually had to think about it.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, at the worktop, seen from the side; the wooden spoon goes still in the bowl; she stays still a moment, eyes resting on the bowl, then slowly starts stirring again. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Quiet, then the spoon again.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, standing at the worktop seen from the side, both hands on a cream ceramic bowl with a wooden spoon resting in it, eyes on the bowl, a calm quiet face. Medium close shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: Then she gave this little laugh and said, I don't think anyone ever has.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves: one hand pours a little beaten egg from a small glass jug into the pale creamed butter while the other stirs with a wooden spoon. A wooden spoon in a bowl.

beats.vo: Fifty-seven birthdays. Not one cake.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves folding the sifted flour into the pale batter with a large metal spoon in slow gentle figure-of-eight turns. The soft fold of batter.

beats.vo: She didn't say it sadly. She said it like she was talking about the weather.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves pressing a circle of baking paper into the bottom of a round cake tin beside a second tin already lined, smoothing it flat with her fingertips. The soft crinkle of baking paper.

beats.vo: I drove home that night, and I couldn't stop thinking about it.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, at the worktop seen from the side, head bowed, eyes on the tins, scrapes the pale batter into the two lined round tins with a spatula, a little more in one than the other. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. The soft scrape of the spatula.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, standing at the worktop seen from the side, head bowed, eyes on two round lined cake tins, a cream bowl of pale batter tipped in one hand, a spatula in the other, a calm ordinary face. Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: She taught me to bake. Every cake I know is one of hers.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, bends and slides the two round tins onto the middle shelf of the small white oven one after the other, then closes the oven door gently with her hand. The oven door stays solid. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. The soft clunk of an oven door.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, bending at the open door of a small white oven seen from the side, a round cake tin in each hand, a calm ordinary face. Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: Butter soft. Don't rush it. That's what she always says.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up through the glass door of the small white oven: two round sponges, already risen, a little domed and pale golden, sit still in their tins under the plain oven light; in real time nothing changes except a faint shimmer of heat (never a time-lapse, the sponges do not grow or crack). The soft hum of an oven.

beats.vo: Her favourite. A Victoria sponge. Mine always come out a little lopsided.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves turning two golden round sponges out of their tins onto a wire rack on the worktop and peeling the baking paper away; one sponge is a little domed and uneven. The soft peel of paper.

beats.vo: I told her to come over for a quiet dinner. That's all. Just dinner.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, sits at the small round table by the window seen from the side, the two sponges cooling on the rack on the worktop behind her; she holds a mug of tea, takes one slow sip and looks out at the garden. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. A mug set down on wood.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, sitting at the small round table by the window seen from the side at a slight angle, a mug of tea in both hands, two golden sponges cooling on a wire rack on the worktop behind her, eyes on the garden, a calm ordinary face. Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: She said, should I bring anything? I said, Mom. Just come.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, at the worktop seen from the side, head bowed, eyes on the bowl, whisks cream by hand in a cream bowl with a balloon whisk, a small smile that slowly settles into concentration. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. The whisk in the cream.
beats.still: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, standing at the worktop seen from the side, head bowed, eyes on a bowl of cream, a balloon whisk in her hand, a small smile. Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: Jam first, then cream. She says the order matters. She's right.
beats.shot: Late afternoon, soft daylight from the window, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves spreading red raspberry jam from a plain glass jar over a slightly domed golden sponge layer with the back of a spoon, jam reaching the uneven edge. The soft spread of jam.

beats.vo: And strawberries on top. The way she always did mine.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of Ellie's hands (slender young hands, short natural pale-pink nails, no rings) in dusty-rose cotton sleeves placing the small whole garden strawberries and raspberries one by one on the whipped cream top of the slightly lopsided sponge cake on the small round table, then two small purple violas, an orange calendula flower and a sprig of mint, each a little uneven. The soft press of fruit into cream.

beats.vo: Seven o'clock. She's here. Right on time, of course.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight, the front step of a small stone cottage. Anne (chin-length soft light-brown hair streaked with grey, side part on her left, tucked behind her right ear, small plain gold stud earrings, fine laugh lines at her eyes), in a light navy cotton jacket, stands on the step in front of the closed white front door, holding a small round biscuit tin in her left hand; she knocks twice with a relaxed right hand, lowers it and waits, tucking her hair behind her ear. The door stays closed and solid in its frame. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Two clear knocks on wood, a far bird.
beats.still: Early evening, soft fading daylight, the front step of a small stone cottage. Anne (chin-length soft light-brown hair streaked with grey, side part on her left, tucked behind her right ear, small plain gold stud earrings, fine laugh lines at her eyes), in a light navy cotton jacket, standing on the step in front of the closed white front door, a small round biscuit tin in her left hand, seen from the side at a slight angle, a calm ordinary face. A whole person, medium-wide shot, the whole door and its frame in view.

beats.vo: And she brought biscuits. Obviously.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight. Over-the-shoulder shot from the front step: Anne's navy jacket shoulder and grey-streaked hair soft in the foreground; the white front door stands open, its edge and frame in view, Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, just inside the frame; she glances down at the biscuit tin Anne holds up, then gives a small amused smile a moment later. Only small movement. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Soft evening sound.
beats.still: Early evening, soft fading daylight. Over-the-shoulder shot from the front step of a small stone cottage: Anne's light navy jacket shoulder and grey-streaked hair soft in the foreground, holding a small round biscuit tin; the white front door stands open, its edge and the door frame clearly in view; Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, stands just inside the frame, her face toward the camera at a slight angle, eyes on her mother, a calm ordinary face. Medium shot.

beats.vo: She came in, and she saw it on the table.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Anne (chin-length soft light-brown hair streaked with grey, side part on her left, tucked behind her right ear, small plain gold stud earrings, fine laugh lines at her eyes), in a soft oatmeal cotton cardigan over a pale-blue cotton blouse, walks two slow steps toward the small round table and stops; her eyes rest on the garden-berry sponge cake on it; she stays still, a calm face that slowly becomes quiet and unsure. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Soft footsteps, then quiet.
beats.still: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Anne (chin-length soft light-brown hair streaked with grey, side part on her left, tucked behind her right ear, small plain gold stud earrings, fine laugh lines at her eyes), in a soft oatmeal cotton cardigan over a pale-blue cotton blouse, standing a step from the small round table seen from the side at a slight angle, a homemade garden-berry sponge cake on the table, a calm ordinary face. Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: She didn't say anything for a while.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Anne (chin-length soft light-brown hair streaked with grey, side part on her left, tucked behind her right ear, small plain gold stud earrings, fine laugh lines at her eyes), in a soft oatmeal cotton cardigan over a pale-blue cotton blouse, by the table, eyes on the cake, a long quiet moment; one hand comes slowly to rest on the back of a chair; she blinks slowly, a calm quiet face. Nothing else moves. Quiet room.

Medium close shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: Then she said, is this for me? Like she really wasn't sure.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Over-the-shoulder shot: Ellie's shoulder in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm and the back of her chestnut braid soft in the foreground; Anne (chin-length soft light-brown hair streaked with grey, side part on her left, tucked behind her right ear, small plain gold stud earrings, fine laugh lines at her eyes), in a soft oatmeal cotton cardigan over a pale-blue cotton blouse, by the table, slowly lifts her eyes from the cake to Ellie and says three quiet words, unsure. Only Anne's mouth moves. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Soft room sound.

beats.vo: I said, happy birthday, Mom. It's only about thirty years late.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Over-the-shoulder shot: Anne's shoulder in a soft oatmeal cotton cardigan over a pale-blue cotton blouse and her grey-streaked hair soft in the foreground; Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, across the table, looks at her mother and says one short soft sentence, then a small warm smile. Only Ellie's mouth moves. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. Soft room sound.

beats.vo: She cut the first slice. And of course, she tried to give it to me.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of the small round table: Anne's hands (oatmeal cardigan sleeves, a thin gold wedding band) lift one slice of garden-berry sponge with a flat cake server onto a small plate and slide the plate across the table; a moment later Ellie's hand in a dusty-rose sleeve slides it gently back. The plate on wood.

beats.vo: I pushed it back. That one's yours, Mom.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Anne (chin-length soft light-brown hair streaked with grey, side part on her left, tucked behind her right ear, small plain gold stud earrings, fine laugh lines at her eyes), in a soft oatmeal cotton cardigan over a pale-blue cotton blouse, sitting at the small round table seen from the side at a slight angle, looks at the slice on the plate for a moment, hesitates, then slowly picks up the fork and takes one small bite, eyes down; a small quiet smile comes slowly after. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. A fork on a plate.

Medium shot, her face at medium size.

beats.vo: Every family has someone who makes the birthdays happen. Ask them when somebody last did it for them.
beats.shot: Early evening, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven, the window soft fading blue dusk, one plain pendant lamp on. A medium-wide side view of the small round table: Ellie (long chestnut-brown hair in a loose low braid over her left shoulder, light freckles across the nose and cheeks, light-hazel eyes), in a dusty-rose cotton jumper with the sleeves pushed to the forearm, and Anne (chin-length soft light-brown hair streaked with grey, side part on her left, tucked behind her right ear, small plain gold stud earrings, fine laugh lines at her eyes), in a soft oatmeal cotton cardigan over a pale-blue cotton blouse, sit across from each other in profile, the cut garden-berry sponge and two mugs of tea between them; Anne says something short, Ellie nods a moment later and lifts her mug. Neither faces the camera. Ordinary everyday movement at real-life speed, a small pause, one small head movement at most, the face stays the same. A mug set on wood, soft room sound.

beats.vo: Then bake the cake. Even a wonky one.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven. Close-up of the slightly lopsided homemade garden-berry sponge cake on the small round table with one slice gone, jam and cream showing in the cut, crumbs on the plate, two mugs of tea steaming beside it. Steam rising slowly. The quiet of the cottage.

beats.vo: Happy birthday, Mom.
beats.shot: Early evening, soft fading daylight at the window, one plain pendant lamp on, her small cottage kitchen: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white butler sink under a window onto the back garden, a small round pale wood table by the window, a small white oven.
